uses.scene-team: Records each supporting department and its participation period for the annual scenario register.
uses.goal: Sets the annual employee and scenario targets used to measure progress.
uses.topic: Creates the initiative tab and groups its scenarios, cases and assets.
uses.scene: Adds a planned scenario to an initiative. Its launch date determines the month it enters production totals.
uses.release: Records a planned asset and its publishing department. First release determines annual builds, monthly additions and contribution rankings.
uses.collection: Counts planned collections. A linked knowledge base and verification date mark a collection as connected.
uses.project: Supplies project totals, AI share and active AI project budgets; groups topics, payments and receivables.
uses.subject: Records project topics and their AI classification to calculate the AI topic share.
uses.expense: Positive amounts are payments and negative amounts are refunds, included on their transaction date.
uses.receivable: Records each contractual due date and amount. Allocated receipts reduce the annual outstanding balance.
uses.receipt: Allocates each receipt to a contract milestone and reduces its balance on the receipt date.
uses.estimate: Estimates annual scenario value as time saved multiplied by hourly rate, plus other savings.
uses.recognition: Effective and end dates distinguish new designations this year from active high-value scenarios.
uses.case: Supplies the featured case, inputs, sample outputs and linked assets on the strategy board.
uses.collection-meta: Groups knowledge connection progress by business category such as procurement, finance or legal.
uses.asset-profile: Supplies business direction for the asset overview and descriptions or Skill rules for asset details.
uses.scene-asset: Links assets to scenarios for a validity period, supplying initiative asset lists and scenario details.
uses.value-rate: Sets hours and hourly rates per deliverable category and unit to value recorded outputs.
